meta.title: Social + video links — verification record
meta.why: FLAGS.md F-19 and review item R-02 recorded that no restaurant carried an Instagram or TikTok link. This file is the verification record behind every social link now published on restaurants.html and activities.html.
meta.rule: A link is published only when (a) the venue's own official page links to it, or (b) the account itself was opened and its bio/posts tie it to the named venue. A bare guess from a username is never enough. Blank means no account could be tied to the venue.
meta.method: Every URL in this file was opened with the page fetcher on 2026-11-27 and read. Where a platform blocked the fetch, the link is recorded only if an official venue page links to it, and 'evidence' says so.
limits: Instagram follower counts, bios and recent-post lists were read on 2026-11-27; they change.

TikTok returned HTTP 400 to every fetch from this sandbox, so no TikTok link is published on the strength of a TikTok page read. The one TikTok link carried over is linked from the venue's own official footer (F-56).
YouTube channel pages were opened for the two venues listed; a channel returning 'This channel doesn't have any content' is not published (F-57).
A dormant account still documents official footage, but its bio may be years out of date — see the Robuchon note (F-54).

restaurants.name: Joël Robuchon
restaurants.evidence: Account opened: title 'Joël Robuchon Restaurant', 9,160 followers, bio links mgmgrand.com/en/restaurants/joel-robuchon-french-restaurant.html (the official page on this site).
restaurants.caveat: Dormant: newest post shown is dated 2020-08-07. Its bio still reads 'Michelin 3-Star' — that is the pre-2010 status; the 2026 Guide gives TWO stars (F-54).

restaurants.name: L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon
restaurants.evidence: The @joelrobuchon.lasvegas account is titled 'Joël Robuchon Restaurant' and links the Restaurant de Joël Robuchon page, not L'Atelier's. Assigning it to L'Atelier would be a guess, so it is left blank.

restaurants.name: Restaurant Guy Savoy
restaurants.evidence: Account opened: title 'Guy Savoy Las Vegas', bio 'Guy Savoy's restaurant at @caesarspalace in Las Vegas', links guysavoylasvegas.com.
restaurants.caveat: Dormant: newest post shown is dated 2023-05-15.

restaurants.name: é by José Andrés

restaurants.name: China Poblano

restaurants.name: Wing Lei
restaurants.evidence: @winglei exists but is a private personal account ('Lei Wing', 659 followers, no venue link) and is explicitly not this restaurant. The Wynn property account is a hotel account, not the restaurant's.

restaurants.name: Mott 32
restaurants.evidence: Account opened: title 'Mott 32 Las Vegas', bio 'World-class destination for elevated Chinese cuisine ... Michelin Guide 2026'.

restaurants.name: COTE Korean Steakhouse
restaurants.evidence: Account opened: bio lists 'NYC | Miami | Singapore | Vegas'.
restaurants.caveat: Brand account covering all COTE cities, not a Las Vegas-only account.

restaurants.name: Bouchon Bistro
restaurants.evidence: No Bouchon Las Vegas account could be tied to the venue; the Venetian restaurant page publishes no social link for it.

restaurants.name: Estiatorio Milos
restaurants.evidence: Account opened and verified-badged: title 'estiatorio Milos', bio '12 restaurants worldwide'.
restaurants.caveat: Group account covering all 12 Milos restaurants.

restaurants.name: Gymkhana
restaurants.evidence: Account opened: bio 'From @gymkhanalondon by @jks_restaurants ... Located at @arialv'.

restaurants.name: Michael Mina
restaurants.evidence: Account opened: title 'MICHAEL MINA', bio 'Contemporary Coastal Cuisine Located in the Heart of the Bellagio'.
restaurants.caveat: Accounts posts through 2026-10; the venue itself is still listed as temporarily closed on Bellagio's own index (F-23). An active feed is not evidence the room is open.

restaurants.name: Anima by EDO
restaurants.evidence: Both: the official site animabyedo.com carries a '@animabyedo / Follow on Instagram' block, and the account opens and its bio links animabyedo.com.

restaurants.name: Kabuto
restaurants.evidence: Both: the official site kabutolv.com embeds this account's posts (instagram.com/p/ links), and the account opens with bio 'Recommended by MICHELIN Guide 2026' and links kabutolv.com/reserve.

restaurants.name: KAME Omakase
restaurants.evidence: Account opened: title 'Kame Omakse', bio 'Kame Omakase Las Vegas', links sushikame.com (the official site named on this site's row).
restaurants.caveat: 178 followers and no posts displayed — a low-activity account. Note the official site itself is a JavaScript shell (F-04).

restaurants.name: Lamaii
restaurants.evidence: Account opened and verified-badged: title 'LAMAII LAS VEGAS', bio 'Managed by Bia Hawang & Bon Atcharawan ... In the MICHELIN Guide 2026 Selection'; posts tag 'LAMAII CHINATOWN 4480 Spring Mountain Rd #700'.
restaurants.caveat: Posts are for the Chinatown room, which is the Michelin-listed one (the Henderson room is a second location).

restaurants.name: Partage
restaurants.evidence: Account opened: title 'Partage | French Restaurant Las Vegas', bio '@michelinguide 2026 recommended', links partage.vegas.

restaurants.name: Sparrow + Wolf
restaurants.evidence: Account opened: title 'SPARROW + WOLF', bio '@chefbrianhoward ... @michelinguide selected'. The official site also has a 'Social Channels' block.

restaurants.name: Esther's Kitchen
restaurants.evidence: Account opened: title 'Esther's Kitchen', bio 'Seasonal Italian Soul Food in the Las Vegas Arts District from James Trees & co.'; a 2026-10-28 post announces receipt of the MICHELIN medallion.

restaurants.name: SoulBelly BBQ
restaurants.evidence: Both: soulbellybbq.com links this exact account from its photo wall, and the account opens with bio 'Michelin Recommended. Voted Best BBQ in Nevada!'
restaurants.caveat: Feed covers both the Main Street (Michelin-listed) room and the SoulBelly Express counter.

restaurants.name: Ping Pang Pong
restaurants.evidence: No Instagram account could be tied to the restaurant. Searches surfaced a Facebook page and parent-property accounts only.

restaurants.name: Pho Ga Bac Bac
restaurants.evidence: @phogabacbac exists but is a private account with 1 follower and no venue link, so it is not adopted. The official site bestchickenpho.com publishes no social link.

restaurants.name: Yen Viet Kitchen
restaurants.evidence: The official site (a Google Sites page) publishes no social link and no account could be tied to the venue.

restaurants.name: Stubborn Seed
restaurants.evidence: @stubbornseed and @stubbornseedlv both return 404. The Resorts World dining page publishes no social link for the venue. Not guessed.

activities.name: Sphere Las Vegas
activities.evidence: Instagram opened and verified-badged ('Sphere', 3.3M followers). YouTube channel opened: it lists videos and 'The Wizard of Oz at Sphere' playlists.

activities.name: High Roller Observation Wheel
activities.evidence: @highrollerlasvegas is a private 26-follower account — not the attraction. @thelinq is the LINQ hotel's verified account and posts about the wheel, but it is a property account, not the attraction's.
activities.caveat: If a property-level account is acceptable, https://www.instagram.com/thelinq/ is the nearest official one (F-58).

activities.name: The Mob Museum
activities.evidence: Instagram opened and verified-badged ('The Mob Museum', 71,833 followers, bio links admission.themobmuseum.org). YouTube channel opened: it lists 'Inside the Life' episodes and 'About The Mob Museum' playlists.

activities.name: The Neon Museum
activities.evidence: Both links are printed in the official neonmuseum.org site navigation ('Tiktok', 'Instagram'). The Instagram handle matches the museum's own YouTube-branded naming.
activities.caveat: TikTok returned HTTP 400 to this sandbox, so the TikTok page itself was not read (F-56). The link comes from the museum's own footer.

activities.name: Fremont Street Experience
activities.evidence: Instagram opened and verified-badged: bio 'Official account of Fremont Street Experience and SlotZilla zipline in downtown #LasVegas'.
